title: Bounded multi-cell TABLECONTENT linked-cell DATALINK writer

scope.operation: Write one linked-data cell inside a bounded rectangular TABLECONTENT grid while preserving scalar peer cells.
scope.profile: Generated 2x2 AC1032 table: one empty-local-content cell linked to one DATALINK and three scalar string cells; ASCII and binary DXF.
limits: One linked cell in the generated profile
Linked cells carry no local contents, block references, attributes or geometry
scope.claim_boundary: Selected DXF serializer and typed readback evidence only; no native application semantics or DWG encoding claim.

implementation: Admit a linked cell in the multi-cell writer only when its handle is valid and its local contents are empty; unlinked cells still require default DATALINK fields.
Emit each linked cell's group 92 flag, remapped group 340 DATALINK target and exact groups 93, 94 and 96 metadata.
Retain adapter preflight graph closure so absent or non-unique DATALINK targets are refused.

physical_wire: One emitted DATALINK record uses handle 0x1710.
The other three grid cells retain scalar/unlinked encoding.
evidence.typed_readback: The TABLECONTENT handle is 0x15A0; the linked cell points to the emitted DATALINK at 0x1710 with row count 2, column count 3 and unknown value -5; scalar peer content is preserved.
evidence.failure_control: Changing the linked-cell target to absent handle 0x799 is refused; an existing destination sentinel and the caller model remain unchanged.
evidence.retry_control: Restoring the valid source target lets the same adapter export again; the result reads back with the remapped graph intact.

remaining: The parent P5 rendering/TABLE phase remains open.
This receipt does not qualify multiple linked cells, nonempty local content in a linked cell, broader DATALINK semantics, native table rendering, or DWG output.
